But it never reached parity/differential testing, so there is no evidence of treating surprising response diffs as evidence to update its model of the reference, and its one structural pivot is re-verified only by compilation, not parity. That places it between the level-5 root-cause fixing and level-8 structural-pivot-plus-reverification anchors.
